name: Attenuator
description: How much an attenuator attenuates as a function of frequency, with a vector network analyzer (VNA): the attenuation (S21) over the sweep, its mean, spread and slope, the deviation from the nominal value, the match at both ports, the attenuation at chosen frequencies, and a pass / fail check against the nominal value with a tolerance or against a mask. For fixed and step attenuators (one setting per measurement). The VNA is calibrated beforehand by the user.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer, calibrated for the connection of the attenuator between port 1 and port 2

attenuator.description: label (identifies the attenuator), asset_id (its code in the registry), nominal_db (the value it should have), tolerance_db (plus / minus, around the nominal value) and setting (which step, for a step attenuator; free text)

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points, scale (linear|log), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm

frequencies_of_interest.description: the attenuation is reported at these frequencies

limits.description: pass / fail mask on the attenuation in dB (positive numbers); replaces the check on nominal_db and tolerance_db: {"bands": [{"from": 0, "to": 6e9, "min": 9, "max": 11}]}

also_return_loss.description: also read S11 and S22 to report the return loss of both ports (true by default)

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to calibrate and connect the attenuator
